scope: Failure and progress archive, not a scored comparison or completion of twenty models
content: Frozen protocol identities, phase exit codes, preflight status and hashes, sampling hardware diagnostics, rejected native-response categories, and dated partial decisions with original hashes
accounting: This inventory does not recompute or assert returns. Seven complete paired cycles have separate independently audited decision/NAV/trade publications. Partial decisions must not be extrapolated, filled with HOLD or scored through the future deadline.
snapshot_limit: Read-only sequential snapshot; active runs may advance during collection. Completed markers alone are not independent accounting validation.
private_exclusions: Raw news, full prompts, model prose and provider transcripts remain on Beacon. Credentials are never published.

claude.state: Prepared only; no execution job submitted and no native relay started
claude.execution: Requires explicit permitted launch after quota recovery; no scheduled launch, heartbeat, retry or account/model fallback is configured
